About Apache Junction & Gold Canyon

Location

East of Mesa, these communities sit at the base of the Superstition Mountains:

  • 40 miles from Scottsdale
  • 35 miles from Phoenix Sky Harbor
  • Gateway to Tonto National Forest

Popular Destinations

  • Lost Dutchman State Park
  • Goldfield Ghost Town
  • Apache Trail Scenic Drive
  • Superstition Mountain wilderness

Transportation Services

Airport Transfers

Professional transfers between Phoenix Sky Harbor and Apache Junction/Gold Canyon communities.

Event Transportation

Renaissance Festival, Superstition Mountain events, and local celebrations with convenient pickup and return.

Day Trip Support

Apache Trail exploration, hiking excursions, and desert adventures with reliable transportation.

Service Area Coverage

  • Apache Junction proper
  • Gold Canyon
  • Superstition Foothills communities
  • Queen Valley
  • Superior (extended area)

Pricing

  • Airport transfer (Sky Harbor): from $225 one way in the Luxury SUV (up to 6) or $295 in the Executive Black Sprinter (up to 14), flat within 15 road miles from pickup to drop-off; longer transfers are priced from the drive with the empty return included
  • Renaissance Festival days, day trips and events: hourly with a 4-hour minimum, $500 in the Luxury SUV, $580 in the Executive Black Sprinter or $700 in the Limo Party Sprinter (up to 16)

Prices are before 8% Arizona sales tax. Every rate is on the pricing page.
